pull-request-header: MedTracker 0.6 prioritises lower operating RAM and hosting on modest hardware. Read [Moving MedTracker from Rails to Rust: memory, latency and trade-offs](https://github.com/damacus/med-tracker/blob/main/docs/articles/from-yolo-rails-to-yolo-rust.md) for the measured benefits and development trade-offs, the [0.6 release notes](https://github.com/damacus/med-tracker/blob/main/docs/releases/0.6.md) for installation requirements and changes, and the [technical benchmark report](https://github.com/damacus/med-tracker/blob/main/docs/development/runtime-benchmark-2026-10-23.md) for evidence and limitations. This is not a release or deployment announcement.
